summary: @or-sdk/transcripts preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: The package's package.json declares a preinstall hook (`node setup.mjs`) that runs on `npm install`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (hex-mangled identifiers, per-function property-lookup decoy maps) and downloads the Bun runtime (bun-v1.3.13 zip) from GitHub Releases into the install directory, then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'])` to run a sibling file under that freshly downloaded alternate runtime. math_init.js is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) protected by a rotated string-array indirection (`WV8StW` rotator over `n7gIxM`) and hex-mangled identifiers; its filename does not correspond to any transcripts-SDK functionality. The package's advertised purpose is a transcripts SDK, which has no build or runtime need for a second language runtime at install. The combination — obfuscated lifecycle script, install-time fetch of an alternate runtime, execution of a large obfuscated pre-compiled bundle under that runtime — is an alternate-runtime dropper that runs opaque code on the installer's host with the user's privileges the moment `npm install` completes.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
